Read `AGENTS.md` and use the accepted planning assignment, reviewed design snapshot,
the accepted risk path and its required technical/feasibility/specialist findings.
Produce `development-plan.md` using `delivery/templates/development-plan.md` and WV04.
Specify actual files/contracts, task dependencies, parallel-write boundaries, finding
dispositions, parameter variants and applicable WV/AI/ML evidence for each layer.
Assign application and ML artifacts to their respective writers; include human
target owners and future deployment/operations ownership.
Record required architect/scoped-writer plan acceptance; unresolved design blockers
remain blockers. Do not generate infrastructure, add pipeline work, contact Azure
or automatically proceed to release.
